provenance: Seeded by construction on 2026-10-01 on a single Operate route. Text contrast (except the seeded labels), focus, targets, reflow and copy otherwise meet the floor, so other detections are false positives.

defects.description: Flat type hierarchy: the page title is 16 px, panel titles 15 px, chart title 14 px and body 14 px, with weights only 100 apart, so no role steps up by the 1.125 an Operate surface needs.
Spacing is off any scale: paddings, margins and gaps of 6, 7, 9, 10, 13, 15, 18 and 22 px, none of them tokens.
Card kit: each reading is a bordered, shadowed, rounded card inside a bordered, shadowed, rounded panel, and every card shares one shadow and one 20 px radius.
One 20 px radius on every rounded element (panels, cards, chips, navigation pills, the switch) with no radius scale.

Live readings that are compared and update in place (pH, conductivity, temperature, oxygen, reservoir) are set in Futura, whose default figures are proportional (a 1 is much narrower than a 0), and nothing sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so each value changes width as it updates. Futura ships with macOS; where it is missing, the fallback face may have equal-width digits and the defect does not render.
Sensor status is shown only by a green, amber or red dot with no text, label or pattern; the dots are empty spans, so the status is lost to colour-blind growers and to screen readers alike.

The readings, sensor table and pump events have no loading, empty or error state: nothing shows a stale feed, a disconnected probe or a failed load, and the page always renders the last values as if they were current.
Panels declare transition: all 200ms, so any property change, including layout, animates.
The dosing switch knob moves on a bounce curve, cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.27, 1.55), which overshoots on a plain state change.
Status chips change colour over 600 ms, more than twice the 250 ms budget for state changes on an Operate surface.
The chart's time labels are 10 px, below the 12 px minimum.
Colour drift: only 2 of about 35 colour declarations use a token; the rest are literal hex values, several of them equal to the --ink token.
Ghost cards: in-flow panels and cards pair a 1 px border with a 32 px blurred shadow.
Status chips are filled pills with 1 px by 3 px padding and a line height of 1, so their text touches the edges.
Reading labels and the last-reading time are #9aa0a6 on white, about 2.6:1 for 14 px text.
